evidence_quotes: Waterwet en waterbesluit, open bodemenergiesysteem, meerdere vergunningen voor dezelfde locatie mogelijk?
rationale: The Dutch District Court Noord-Holland decision explicitly concerns permitting under the Water Act (Waterwet) and Water Decree (Waterbesluit) for an open aquifer thermal energy storage / groundwater abstraction-infiltration system (open bodemenergiesysteem), specifically addressing whether multiple permits can be granted for the same location. This squarely falls under WATER and regulatory_permit, with no household utility connection refusal or informal settlement involvement.
